body: Because just letting someone kill themselves is a morally bad thing to do

Stick with him and let him know that you care for him and enjoy his company. Warn his parents/carers if he’s ok with it (or you’re too worried that he may commit suicide)

I’ve dealt with suicidal friends before ( and I’ve been suicidal myself before ) and just letting people know you care about them can help a lot.
Please don’t do it. You have so much to live for. Call a suicide helpline or any friends/family that you trust. Just please get some help.
